svg.title: Can It Ford? pipeline overview
svg.desc: Five-stage pipeline: video frames to Gaussian splat reconstruction to MPM particle seeding to Genesis MPM simulation to ford/no-ford verdict. Below the main pipeline, three abstraction levels (L0, L1, L2) feed into the verdict node.
svg.text: L1 and L2 diverge at d=0.30 m, v=1.5 m/s because D x V cannot represent
directional lateral drag. Finding is friction-invariant (mu 0.0 to 0.7).
L1 verdict: FORD (haz=0.45 < 0.60). L2 verdict: NO-FORD.
